title: Automated Social Media Content Generator
description:
Small businesses need regular posts on several social networks but rarely have time to write them. A tool should create posts, captions and hashtags from a short description of the business, its audience and the topic, in the right format and length for each platform.

Constraints

  • Different formats per platform (for example Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X) with their length limits.
  • Only facts from the brief: no invented prices, discounts or dates.
  • A person reviews every post before it is published.
  • Output that can be imported into a scheduling tool.
goals:
• A week of posts for four platforms is generated from one brief in under 10 minutes.
  • All generated posts stay within each platform's length limit.
  • At least 8 out of 10 posts are published with only minor edits during a four-week trial.
  • No post contains facts that are not in the brief, checked during review.
